policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Humanoid robots have officially surpassed Usain Bolt's 100-meter dash record, with Tiangong Ultra recording 9.39 seconds and Honor-developed Lightning at 9.47 seconds during the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.
Slovakia has detected a Russian backdoor within traffic speed cameras, raising concerns about potential security vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure.

GrapheneOS, an open-source Android variant focused on security and privacy, announced plans to support Motorola smartphones next year, starting with flagships before expanding to foldables and other models.

world.summary: Iran has threatened to retaliate against any country that collaborates with fresh U.S. sanctions, which the U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has described as the "single greatest financial offensive ever."

New Zealand's government plans to introduce legislation banning social media access for individuals under 16, although the proposal faces opposition from some Members of Parliament who doubt its effectiveness.

us.summary: Nearly 90,000 residents near Reno, Nevada, were ordered to evacuate as an uncontained wildfire expanded, burning approximately 10,500 acres.
U.S. forces carried out a strike on a boat in the eastern Pacific, resulting in two fatalities, according to the Pentagon.

Two weeks after a severe storm impacted Northwest Indiana, more than 10,000 residents remain without power, raising concerns among some about the pace of restoration in predominantly Black communities.

science.summary: Research indicates that high-intensity sprints can induce specific molecular changes in the bloodstream, contributing to scientists' understanding of how varying exercise intensities trigger distinct physiological responses.

Recent scientific discussions have covered the discovery of a new type of black hole star, identified specific types of exercise that are linked to a lowered risk of dementia, and explored the unique winter adaptations of the long-clawed shrew.
